notes.title: Promenade Patch V1.1.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Judder effect is fixed: now the FPS matches the refresh rate
[*] The bloom can now be deactivated. Players experiencing the blooming text being out of control can now set the brightness to 0% and play the game normally.
[*] We worked on the color calibration for the whole game. Promenade’s colors have never been so vivid!
[*] Addition of a Chinese localization!
[*] Addition of a Japanese localization!
[/list]

notes.title: Promenade Patch V1.0.4: Final Boss Fight should be bug-free \o/ !!!
notes.content:
[b]Bug fixes :[/b]

[list]
[*] No more random despawning of the final Boss 
[*] Respawn point properly set near the throne after defeating the final boss
[*] Ongoing sounds are now properly stopped when needed (for instance, the sound emitted by a cog)
[*] Lady Screech softlock
[*] Camera issues in the Masked Demon's Lair
[*] The pelican will not disappear anymore when entering Mr Boss' Lair
[/list]

notes.title: Promenade Patch V1.0.3: Mostly introducing async loading
notes.content:
[b]Adding asynchronous level loading:[/b]

[list]
[*] This patch mainly adds asynchronous level loading, which should enhance performance for slower computers
[/list]


[b]Other Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Level were sometimes not properly unloaded when going back to the Great Elevator from the pause menu
[*] The patch 1.0.2 introduced a bug that sometimes cancelled your double jump for seemingly no reason
[/list]

notes.title: Promenade new patch 1.0.2 : bug fixes and gameplay tweaks
notes.content:
[b][u]Gameplay Tweaks : [/u][/b]

[list]
[*]  [b]Now pressing jump mid air is the ONLY way of doing a double jump. Pressing "down" + "throw" doesn't work anymore[/b]
[*] When holding the UP direction with a flying bird in the hands, the Nemo now flies upward faster
[*] Clouds are more forgiving in the Tumult, Nemo must be in contact with the clouds for 0,5 sec
[*] Slinghops can now be prevented by inputing a direction opposed to Nemo's momentum
[*] Adding a jump buffer: checking if Nemo will be landing on the ground in the next few frames, thus preventing a double jump that would use the object in his hands
[*] Adding a rolling buffer: checking if Nemo will be landing on the ground in the next few frames, thus preventing throwing the poulp downwards
[*] Changing the visual aspect of the cogs that the player already collected, making them more distinct from uncollected cogs
[/list]


[u][b]Bug Fixes :[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Small spelling errors for the english localization (it seems like I can't spell the word "developer")
[*] The "Madeline would be proud" achievment now properly unlocks
[*] Fixing the bug of the empty bubbles for the cauldron and the chicken guy
[*] Properly healing the player when collecting a full cog if the "skip catch cog animation" option is enabled
[*] In the museum, sometims objects were destroyed by touching the pedestal before getting registered
[*] Fixing the crashes in space when changing area with the spaceship
[*] Properly resetting power up boss fight when the player miraculously manages to die at the same time as the boss
[*] The chicken's position is properly reset in the Memory Lane trial
[*] Fixing some camera jank in Verdant Voyage's houses
[*] Players cannot get stuck inside the mole's colliders when staying on top of them anymore
[*] Making the Masked Demon's Lair pieces are now invulnerable to explosions
[*] Masked Demon's Lair entrance cannot be open with no piece connected to the entrance anymore
[*] Fixing a small visual issue that misplaced the poulp to the left or right after collecting a powerup
[*] Other very minor tweaks…
[/list]

notes.title: Patch note V1.0.1
notes.content:
Various Bug Fixes : 
- Fixing the empty bubbles during the game's ending (I hope not too many people had this bug xD)
- Dynamically updating the localization explaining the rolling mechanic at the end of the tutorial if the player changes the language
- Making maze pieces invulnerable to explosions
- Adding a version indicator in the corner of the title menu
- Convoluted and very minor other fixes
